import { type PropertyValues } from 'lit';
import { FormElement } from '../catalog-support.js';
import type { TextInputContract } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
export declare class TextInput extends FormElement {
    static formAssociated: boolean;
    static properties: {
        value: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        defaultValue: {
            attribute: string;
        };
        type: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        autocomplete: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        inputMode: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        readOnly: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        minLength: {
            type: NumberConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        maxLength: {
            type: NumberConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        pattern: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        status: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        size: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        iconAction: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
    };
    value: string | undefined;
    defaultValue: string | undefined;
    type: NonNullable<TextInputContract['type']>;
    autocomplete: string;
    inputMode: string;
    readOnly: boolean;
    minLength: number | undefined;
    maxLength: number | undefined;
    pattern: string | undefined;
    status: NonNullable<TextInputContract['status']>;
    size: NonNullable<TextInputContract['size']>;
    iconAction: TextInputContract['iconAction'];
    private state;
    private composing;
    private compositionDraft;
    constructor();
    get committedValue(): string;
    resetControl(): void;
    restoreControl(value: string | FormData | File | null): void;
    updated(_changed: PropertyValues): void;
    private input;
    render(): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
}
